Grizzly_Thick_Shaggy_Fur.description: The grizzly thick shaggy fur is a dense, interlocking coat that serves as a natural barrier, enhancing the creature's constitution and providing an additional layer of protection against both slashing attacks and the biting cold of arctic winds.

Polar_Bear_Dense_White_Coat.description: The Polar Bear's Dense White Coat is a thick, frost-kissed pelt that not only bolsters the bear's constitution, granting it resilience against the biting cold, but also enhances its ability to blend into the snowy landscapes, granting a subtle edge in stealth and concealment.

Black_Bear_Sleek_Dark_Pelt.description: The sleek, dark pelt of the Black_Bear_Sleek_Dark_Pelt component is not only a marvel of natural camouflage, blending seamlessly with the shadows, but also enhances the bear's agility, allowing it to move with the silent grace of a shadow dancer through the densest undergrowth.

Panda_Striking_Two_Tone_Fur.description: This component bestows upon the bear a striking coat of two-tone fur, vibrant and captivating, enhancing both its physical resilience and charisma, making it an imposing yet charming presence on the battlefield.

Sun_Bear_Short_Glossy_Coat.description: This sleek, glossy coat, naturally woven with threads of resilience and agility, not only enhances the bear's evasive maneuvers but also bestows upon it a remarkable resistance to the scorching heat and fiery onslaughts of its adversaries.

Sloth_Bear_Long_Unkempt_Hair.description: The Sloth Bear's long unkempt hair forms a shaggy, near-impenetrable coat that not only boosts its Constitution, granting it an aura of resilience, but also enhances its natural armor, rendering it more resistant to piercing attacks.

Spectacled_Bear_Marked_Hide.description: The marked hide of the Spectacled Bear, with its intricate patterns of black fur on a golden backdrop, not only grants the wearer heightened perception and charisma but also imbues them with the skill Alert, enhancing their vigilance and charm in the wilderness.

Cave_Bear_Prehistoric_Pelt.description: This ancient pelt, once the revered hide of a prehistoric cave bear, is thick and resilient, offering a natural armor that deflects blows and a constitution that bolsters the wearer's endurance, while its innate magical properties grant resistance to both cold and bludgeoning attacks, and the ability to block incoming strikes with primal force.

Zombie_Bear_Matted_Rotting_Fur.description: This matted, rotting fur clings to the undead bear like a toxic shroud, enhancing its resilience to poison while exuding a foul aura that repels all who draw near, sapping their vitality with each breath.

Spirit_Bear_Ghostly_Aura.description: Enveloped in a spectral aura that grants near-invisibility, the Spirit Bear Ghostly Aura is an ethereal blend of Ursine majesty and otherworldly magic, enhancing the wearer’s wisdom and evasion while bestowing the chilling ability to resist piercing attacks and vanish into the shadows.
